name: World clock
summary: The time where your team, clients and family are, at a glance.
description:
List the places you care about in the widget's settings, separated by commas. A city name is usually enough (Tokyo, Paris, Toronto); for anything else use a time zone like America/Sao_Paulo, or name it yourself: Mum=Europe/Lisbon.

Each clock shows how far ahead or behind you it is, and whether it's working hours or night there, so you know when to call.

settings.label: Places (cities or time zones, comma separated)
